verdict.rationale: Godot imports any file placed in the project folder automatically, with no hand-clicking per asset ([godot-docs-17], [godot-docs-9]). Import plugins let custom resource types be processed as first-class imports ([godot-docs-21]), import parameters can be changed across many assets at once ([godot-docs-15]), and EditorScript/editor plugins support scripted pipeline tooling ([godot-docs-5], [godot-docs-4]). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of saved import presets or default-preset configuration, documented post-import hook scripts, an explicitly evidenced headless/CLI batch reimport for CI pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration.
